items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember Pee Wee Hunt doing 'The Music Goes Round and Round.' ... [INTERVIEWEE] In the Paramount.

ctx.x: the Casa Loma they came along and they wanted to pay me off on standby money when they come in and play at the Paramount and they played there quite a bit. They had a Camel show, the 'Camel Caravan' and --
I remember as a kid my mother taking me to see them and I remember Pee Wee Hunt doing 'The Music Goes Round and Round.' That was about 1935 or '6.
